title: Asahina Mafuyu — Thrown Words〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The lyrics are coming along well. But our new song is the one that Kanade made specifically for Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A cloudy sky with rays of light shining barely through while a girl looking up...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's Ena's artwork too, so I may want to make the lyrics match more closely with it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<K's on mute until 25:00.
She said she wants to concentrate.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright. I guess it'll be a little quiet for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? I'm hardly obnoxious or anything. Especially as long as Amia doesn't bug me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yes, really! And as long as you don't say anything weird.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now, I'll go back to working quietly.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh... I should've asked her about her art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I wanted you to see my rough draft.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You showed your lyrics to K yesterday, right? I was hoping to draw something more reflective of what you wrote. Is that okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (A girl's hunched over on the ground while it's raining...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <There isn't much else other than the overall design, so I can't say much...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, the way I said that might make her mad...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ah, okay... I'll try to develop the subject matter a little more then...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If I got mad at every word you said, I'd end up pulling all my hair out.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is there something you want to ask? It sounds like you've at least reached the point of being able to so...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <This is just what I thought I've been seeing, but why do you get mad so much, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because I'm proud of my work and what I do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you worked genuinely hard on something and though it was good but are told it wasn't, you'd be mad too, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I want to hear what others think in this case, so I'm prepared to receive some criticism.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Does that mean you want to improve your art despite any negative feedback or thoughts?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Of course I do! I wouldn't be able to keep drawing like this if I didn't!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I still don't really understand that. But the ability to cling to one thing so tightly...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Cling...? Can't you say that in a way that doesn't make me sound desperate?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't have anything that makes me passionate or heated like you, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't even know what the real me wants to actually do with herself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But there's a big difference between not having anything and not knowing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyways, I need to get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The difference between not having anything and not knowing...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So I should try to learn more then...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That may be difficult for me...
